evidence: RetiSpec is an artificial intelligence medical imaging company developing a tool for the early detection of disease biomarkers in the eye
During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company made an additional investment of $2.8 million
The Company also recognized a $3.7 million revaluation gain during the year ended December 31, 2024
has a total of 20% ownership interest at December 31, 2025
ai_positioning.summary: Gentex intègre l'IA via des investissements stratégiques dans des startups spécialisées (RetiSpec pour l'imagerie médicale), plutôt que de développer ses propres modèles. La société adopte une approche de capital-investissement pour accéder aux technologies IA émergentes.
